name: Men With Long Hair
overview: Scripture addresses the appearance and distinction of men and women, emphasizing clear boundaries in dress and grooming as expressions of God's order. Leviticus 19:27 instructs against altering the natural shape of the hair and beard, while Deuteronomy 22:5 forbids men from wearing women's garments and vice versa, labeling such practices as abominations before the Lord. Numbers 6:1 introduces the Lord's commands to Moses, underscoring that these instructions come directly from God, highlighting their importance in maintaining holiness and distinction among His people.
